WITH parks_in_barren_county AS (
  SELECT id, geometry
  FROM parks
  WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Barren County' AND border_type = 'county' AND addr_state = 'KY'))
    AND park_name ILIKE '%theme park%'
),
elevated_parks AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM parks_in_barren_county
  WHERE ST_Value(
    (SELECT rast FROM public.dem_us WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, parks_in_barren_county.geometry)),
    ST_SetSRID(parks_in_barren_county.geometry, 4326)::geometry
  ) > 300
)
SELECT count FROM elevated_parks;
